# Reference
## Websites
<details><summary><code>client.websites.<a href="/src/api/resources/websites/client/Client.ts">retrieve</a>({ ...params }) -> Channel3Api.Website | null</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Resolve a website URL to its ID and best_commission_rate. Tip: website_ids filters accept domains directly, so this lookup is most useful for retrieving commission rates.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
await client.websites.retrieve({
    query: "query"
});

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.RetrieveWebsitesRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `WebsitesClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

## Products
<details><summary><code>client.products.<a href="/src/api/resources/products/client/Client.ts">search</a>({ ...params }) -> core.Page&lt;Channel3Api.Product, Channel3Api.SearchResponse&gt;</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Search for products with pagination support.

At least one of `query`, `image_url`, `base64_image`, or `page_token` must be
provided; requests with none of these will return 422.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.products.search();
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.products.search();
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.SearchRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `ProductsClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

<details><summary><code>client.products.<a href="/src/api/resources/products/client/Client.ts">browse</a>({ ...params }) -> core.Page&lt;Channel3Api.Product, Channel3Api.SearchResponse&gt;</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

List and page through products for a set of filters.

Useful for a static, grid view of products for a brand, website, or category.

At least one of `filters.brand_ids`, `filters.category_ids`, or
`filters.website_ids` must be provided, unless `config.collection_id` is set.

Pagination is capped at 5 pages per browse; `next_page_token` is null on
the final page. Contact support@trychannel3.com for deeper paging.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.products.browse();
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.products.browse();
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.BrowseRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `ProductsClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

<details><summary><code>client.products.<a href="/src/api/resources/products/client/Client.ts">findSimilar</a>({ ...params }) -> core.Page&lt;Channel3Api.Product, Channel3Api.SearchResponse&gt;</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Find products similar to a given product.

Consider setting ``filters`` to narrow results to the
same gender, brand, category, price range, etc. when you only want
similar items within a specific slice of the catalog. Pass
``config.collection_id`` to keep neighbors inside a saved collection.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.products.findSimilar({
    product_id: "product_id"
});
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.products.findSimilar({
    product_id: "product_id"
});
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.SimilarProductsRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `ProductsClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

<details><summary><code>client.products.<a href="/src/api/resources/products/client/Client.ts">monetize</a>({ ...params }) -> Channel3Api.MonetizeResponse</code></summary>
<dl>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

## Reporting
<details><summary><code>client.reporting.<a href="/src/api/resources/reporting/client/Client.ts">listClicks</a>({ ...params }) -> core.Page&lt;Channel3Api.Click, Channel3Api.ClicksResponse&gt;</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

List clicks for your account over a datetime window.

Defaults to the last 30 days ending now. Maximum window is 90 days.
Pass an offset-aware ISO datetime to express local time (e.g. last 6 hours).
Returns a summary plus a paginated list of click events (most recent first).
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.reporting.listClicks();
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.reporting.listClicks();
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.ListClicksReportingRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `ReportingClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

<details><summary><code>client.reporting.<a href="/src/api/resources/reporting/client/Client.ts">listTransactions</a>({ ...params }) -> core.Page&lt;Channel3Api.Transaction, Channel3Api.TransactionsResponse&gt;</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

List transactions for your account over a datetime window.

Defaults to the last 30 days ending now. Maximum window is 90 days.
Pass an offset-aware ISO datetime to express local time (e.g. last 6 hours).
Returns a summary of net commission (after take rate) plus a paginated list
of transactions (most recent first). Network-approved commissions appear as
pending.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.reporting.listTransactions();
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.reporting.listTransactions();
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### ⚙️ Parameters

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

**request:** `Channel3Api.ListTransactionsReportingRequest` 
    
</dd>
</dl>

<dl>
<dd>

**requestOptions:** `ReportingClient.RequestOptions` 
    
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
</dl>
</details>

<details><summary><code>client.collections.<a href="/src/api/resources/collections/client/Client.ts">create</a>({ ...params }) -> Channel3Api.CollectionResponse</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Create a collection. Clauses are optional so an empty collection can be curated later.

#### 📝 Description

<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Name objects in a scene image, localize them, and search the catalog per crop.

Charges 1 credit for the call plus 1 credit per detected thing. ``filters``
apply to every per-thing search. ``limit`` is per thing, not across the
whole response.

</dd>

</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
const pageableResponse = await client.priceTracking.listSubscriptions();
for await (const item of pageableResponse) {
    console.log(item);
}

// Or you can manually iterate page-by-page
let page = await client.priceTracking.listSubscriptions();
while (page.hasNextPage()) {
    page = page.getNextPage();
}

// You can also access the underlying response
const response = page.response;

```

<details><summary><code>client.conversations.clientTokens.<a href="/src/api/resources/conversations/resources/clientTokens/client/Client.ts">create</a>({ ...params }) -> Channel3Api.ClientTokenResponse</code></summary>
<dl>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dd>

Mint a short-lived, browser-safe token. With ``conversation_id`` the token continues and reads that thread; without it, the token's first turn creates the thread and binds the token to it.

</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>

<details><summary><code>client.conversations.clientTokens.<a href="/src/api/resources/conversations/resources/clientTokens/client/Client.ts">revoke</a>({ ...params }) -> void</code></summary>
<dl>
<dd>

#### 📝 Description

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

Revoke a client token immediately. The token travels in the request body, not the URL, so it stays out of access logs; only the minting vendor can revoke it.
</dd>
</dl>
</dd>
</dl>

#### 🔌 Usage

<dl>
<dd>

<dl>
<dd>

```typescript
await client.conversations.clientTokens.revoke({

});
```

</dd>
</dl>

</dl>
</dd>
</dl>


</dd>
